hotels.title: Hong Kong Harbourside Luxury with Club Lounge Access, Daily Breakfast & Nightly Free-Flow Cocktails
hotels.description: Showstopping skyline vistas and curated luxury amenities await at Harbour Grand Hong Kong, where every room overlooks the spectacular Victoria Harbour and onsite facilities leave little to be desired. Float your worries away in the 27-metre infinity pool overlooking Hong Kong, or ascend to the Harbour Club Lounge for complimentary afternoon tea and evening cocktails high above the city's buzz. Indulgence is easy with Le 188° Restaurant & Lounge boasting modern European cuisine along with striking top-floor views, while Kwan Cheuk Heen serves up mouthwatering Cantonese classics. In between wining and dining, head to the seventh-floor spa, offering heavenly treatments and massages in a serene setting that will make you feel worlds away. The hotel's coveted location in North Point places you within easy reach of authentic street food, vintage shopping and Victoria Park's emerald escape just a short MTR journey from your door. You'll feel intimately connected to local life, yet within effortless reach of Causeway Bay’s high‑end boutiques and designer enclaves.
